votes.quote: **Delivery order isn't guaranteed.** Up to 10 attempts per tenant run concurrently, and retries go back into the queue. The brief doesn't ask for ordering, and strict per-tenant FIFO would make one bad event block the whole tenant. *Question:* do any destinations assume order?
